> A PCB design to to use it for a robotic arm project (basically Breach is a character in valorant having a mechanical arm.) So this PCB will have a power supply for motors and slots for connecting the motor. Then It will have pins to connect the XIAO RP2040 microcontroller (basically the microcontroller for this project).
